children: Citi published a research report on LI AUTO-W

, of which 3Q results beat. Its quarterly net loss was RMB314 million, better than the market expectation for a RMB926 million loss, mainly driven by vehicle GPM reaching 15.3%, up 5.8 ppts QoQ and 3 ppts above market expectations. The broker also assigned a positive 30-day short-term view on the stock.
The broker noted that Li Auto's reduced use of CATL batteries improved profitability. The improvement in vehicle GPM was partly attributable to the proportion of battery supply from SUNWODA
, which hiked from 5% in 2Q26 to 45% in 3Q26, offsetting rising memory prices. Citi estimated this contributed around 3.2 ppts to the increase in 3Q vehicle gross margin.
Citi maintained its Neutral rating on LI AUTO-W. The broker cut the US share TP for Li Auto Inc.
from USD14 to USD12.6, and lowered the H-share TP from HKD53.7 to HKD48.5.
